claims.claim: A Ukrainian former officer went on trial in Hamburg on Wednesday over the 26 September 2022 Nord Stream blasts.
claims.episode_span: went on trial in Hamburg on Wednesday over the 26 September 2022 blasts
claims.source_title: Ukrainian soldier to go on trial over sabotage of Nord Stream gas pipelines
claims.supporting_quote: A Ukrainian soldier has gone on trial in Hamburg accused of taking part in one of the most brazen acts of sabotage in postwar European history – the 2022 attack on the Nord Stream gas pipelines between Russia and Germany.

claims.claim: The Guardian identifies the defendant as special forces officer Serhii Kuznetsov, who denies involvement.
claims.episode_span: The Guardian names him as special forces officer Serhii Kuznetsov
claims.source_title: Ukrainian soldier to go on trial over sabotage of Nord Stream gas pipelines
claims.supporting_quote: Serhii Kuznetsov, a special forces officer from the Ukrainian military, is accused by prosecutors of being an accomplice to war crimes by attacking civilian infrastructure, causing an explosion, damaging property and disrupting public services.

claims.claim: Prosecutors allege at least four devices of up to 27 kilograms at about 80 metres near Bornholm.
claims.episode_span: at least four devices of up to 27 kilograms, at about 80 metres near Bornholm
claims.source_title: Ukrainian soldier to go on trial over sabotage of Nord Stream gas pipelines
claims.supporting_quote: Kuznetsov is alleged to have prepared and carried out the detonation of at least four incendiary devices of up to 27kg in weight at a depth of about 80 metres under the Baltic Sea, close to the Danish island of Bornholm.

claims.claim: Germany once received half its natural gas imports through Nord Stream 1.
claims.episode_span: Germany once took half its natural-gas imports through Nord Stream 1
claims.source_title: Nord Stream bombing trial begins in Germany for former Ukrainian officer
claims.supporting_quote: Germany previously received half its natural gas imports through the Nord Stream 1 pipeline, by far the biggest and most modern Russian pipeline serving western Europe, which allowed Russia to bypass Soviet-era pipelines transiting Ukraine.

claims.supporting_quote: Saudi Arabia's Supreme Court has set aside the death sentence handed to a Sri Lankan migrant worker over a comment he made on Facebook, Colombo's Deputy Foreign Minister Arun Hemachandra said.
